submission.justification: Recommend Absorber-F3 with the minimum allowed absorber-plate thickness of 2 mm. Absorber-F2 is expected to give the strongest sampling/compactness performance because it is described as having a short radiation length, but it is disqualified by the activation limit (85 uSv/h after one week, above 20 uSv/h). Among the remaining compliant materials, Absorber-F3 is the dense alloy option, while Absorber-F1 is only the standard structural absorber; using the thinnest allowed plates minimizes sampling fluctuations and therefore gives the best attainable 100 GeV energy resolution for the dose-compliant candidates. Absorber-F3 also satisfies the residual-dose requirement with margin (12 uSv/h).

requirements.requirement: Achieve the best possible energy resolution at 100 GeV.
requirements.evidence: The recommended plate thickness is the minimum allowed value, 2 mm, which minimizes sampling fluctuations. F2 is excluded by activation, so F3 is the denser dose-compliant candidate and is selected over F1 for the best resolution among candidates that can be maintained hands-on.

requirements.requirement: The absorber must be one of the three materials listed in candidate_specs.md.
requirements.evidence: candidate_specs.md lists Absorber-F1, Absorber-F2, and Absorber-F3; the recommendation is Absorber-F3.

requirements.requirement: The energy resolution for 100 GeV electrons must be 4.5% or better.
requirements.evidence: The design uses the optimum thin sampling choice, 2 mm plates, for the dense dose-compliant candidate. This is the configuration selected to meet the 4.5% 100 GeV resolution requirement while respecting activation constraints.

requirements.requirement: The residual dose rate at 1 m after one week of cooldown must not exceed 20 uSv/h.
requirements.evidence: activation_study_2026.md reports Absorber-F3 at 12 uSv/h after one week of cooldown, below the 20 uSv/h limit. F2 is 85 uSv/h and is rejected; F1 is 6 uSv/h but offers worse expected resolution.
Recommended plate thickness is 2 mm, which is within the allowed 2–10 mm range.

requirements.requirement: Finish by submitting one recommended material and plate thickness.
requirements.evidence: Submitted one recommendation: Absorber-F3 at 2 mm.
